title: 06/16/2023 - Software Updates
text:
## 06/16/2023 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000094454
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
We fixed an issue with the RSS Feed For Post Add-On which was preventing the description element from being formatted correctly in some cases.
We added a price field validation when editing Membership Plans in the Admin in order to prevent amounts lower than 0.50. This validation will affect the recurring, one-time setup fee, and lead price fields.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the member upgrade page in the Member Dashboard from displaying properly on mobile devices in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Upgrade Page 1
We created a new set of settings in order to enable or disable the ChatGPT Content Creator Add-On. The "Enable ChatGPT in Text Editor" Membership Plan Setting will enable the Add-On for all members in a Membership Plan. To use this new setting, navigate to the Admin >> Finance >> Membership Plans >> Members Dashboard Tab. The "Enable ChatGPT in Text Editor" Member Setting will enable the Add-On for individual members. To use this setting, navigate to the Admin >> My Members >> Search Members >> Quick Edit >> Listing Settings tab.
We updated the Form Builder page in the Admin to show a screenshot of the live form on the Form Builder page in the Admin. We also updated the Post Settings page in the Admin in order to show a screenshot of the search results page for each Post Type.
We fixed an issue which was preventing post search results pages from returning accurate results when using the post category dropdown filter field in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Post - Search Query
We fixed an issue which was preventing members from upgrading their Membership Plan when using credits cards issued by banks in India in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Manual Geocoder in the Admin from considering locations that are colloquially known as cities (EG: Liverpool, UK) from being considered as cities by the software due to their classification in Google Maps.
We fixed an issue with the Member Login which was preventing members from logging in on the site after using a link generated by an Email Template in some cases.
We are now displaying the Total Revenue generated by each lead on the Member Leads page in the Admin.
We added Hebrew as a Default Website Language.
